title: Claude AI for Trading and Investing: A Trader’s Playbook for Claude and Claude Code — Sess
description: It’s 8:40 AM. You have fourteen tabs open and twenty minutes to decide on a trade. Four charts. Your broker platform. An economic calendar. A news site you don’t trust. Two videos from last night you never finished. A spreadsheet you meant to update in March. Someone’s Discord, then someone else’s. A blog post about the euro. And a trading journal with eleven entries, the last one from a Tuesday four months ago. You don’t have an information problem. You have no process — and more information has never once built one. Here is the part nobody says out loud. Nothing on that screen knows anything about you. Now add one tab that does. It knows your two instruments. It knows your contract size and your $300 daily loss limit. It knows you add to losers on a Friday afternoon. You drop last month’s trades in, and ninety seconds later there is a table — your result per setup, your win rate, and how wide the error bar around that number really is. Underneath it, something you never asked for: 11 of your 14 worst trades came after 2:00 PM. That is what Claude AI is for a trader. Not a crystal ball. A fast, patient helper that has read everything you have ever written about your own trading, and never once gets bored of it. What you will build: A desk that knows your rules. Instructions, projects, and a rules file, set up once, so you stop retyping your trading plan every morning. A session brief that writes itself while the kettle boils. Four markets, four clocks, fifteen minutes on a Sunday. A chart review that admits what it is not sure about , instead of handing you a horoscope. A sizing check that catches a misplaced decimal before your broker does — futures, forex, crypto and gold, one formula. title: Applied AI for Industrial Operations: Generative AI, Digital Twins, BIM, Predictive Mainte
description: AI is moving from dashboards into job sites, plants, facilities, and capital projects. Applied AI for Industrial Operations is a practical guide for engineering leaders who need to use generative AI in real work: RFPs, vendor proposals, BIM readiness, MEP coordination, digital twins, predictive maintenance, SCADA and IoT reports, Lean Six Sigma bottlenecks, safety, QA/QC, change orders, and executive handover. Written for civil engineers, construction managers, mechanical engineers, maintenance leaders, industrial engineers, plant managers, and operations executives, this book shows how to turn field notes, OEM manuals, sensor data, site constraints, and project disputes into clear decisions and defensible operating documents. Inside, you will learn how to use AI to: Build go/no-go feasibility triage for complex industrial projects. Draft stronger scopes of work, RFPs, vendor questions, and proposal audits. Assess BIM and digital twin readiness before expensive implementation. Translate SCADA, IoT, and maintenance signals into executive risk reports. Improve predictive maintenance, commissioning, QA/QC, safety, and ESG tracking. Use Lean Six Sigma thinking to identify bottlenecks, downtime, waste, and layout constraints. Defend margins with clearer change orders, RACI matrices, RFIs, and handover documents. This is not a programming book. It is a field-focused operating manual for professionals who manage physical systems, vendors, crews, equipment, infrastructure, and risk. title: Obsolete: The AI Industry’s Trillion Dollar Race to Replace Us—and How to Stop It
description: Is AI a bubble or humanity’s last invention? An existing harm or an existential threat? Obsolete cuts through the hype and false binaries to answer all the AI questions you have, while raising some you probably aren’t prepared for. The richest companies in history are racing to build a machine that replaces human labor— all of it . And, as this provocative new book insists, the only surefire way they won’t succeed is if we stop them. Many today don’t get further than seeing AI as a boondoggle—a new shiny object for techno-capitalists to sink their cash into as we barrel toward climate disaster. Obsolete takes those concerns seriously, but implores us to keep our eye on the ball: the attempt to render you obsolete . The scale of their project has no real precedent. What we think of as big—the Gilded Age monopolies, the Manhattan Project, the Apollo program—doesn’t even come close to capturing its size. Almost none of us wants this vast transformation to succeed. Yet we’re letting it proceed virtually unabated. Why? Because we don’t know it’s happening, we don’t believe it will work, or we don’t think we can stop it. Obsolete takes on all three. AI expert and journalist Garrison Lovely’s debut is a refreshing reset on an AI debate in which basically everyone is getting some big things wrong. This book shows how AI actually works in real production environments. No hype. No unrealistic promises. No theory without application. Only practical logic from the shop floor. It is written from inside it. Based on real experience, real constraints, and real decisions. If you are a: Production Manager Planner Engineer Operations Leader This book will help you understand how to move from idea to execution. AI will not replace your production system. title: Industrial AI: Applications with Sustainable Performance (Business and Management)
description: This book introduces Industrial AI in multiple dimensions. Industrial AI is a systematic discipline which focuses on developing, validating and deploying various machine learning algorithms for industrial applications with sustainable performance. Combined with the state-of-the-art sensing, communication and big data analytics platforms, a systematic Industrial AI methodology will allow integration of physical systems with computational models. The concept of Industrial AI is in infancy stage and may encompass the collective use of technologies such as Internet of Things, Cyber-Physical Systems and Big Data Analytics under the Industry 4.0 initiative where embedded computing devices, smart objects and the physical environment interact with each other to reach intended goals. A broad range of Industries including automotive, aerospace, healthcare, semiconductors, energy, transportation, mining, construction, and industrial automation could harness the power of Industrial AI to gain insights into the invisible relationship of the operation conditions and further use that insight to optimize their uptime, productivity and efficiency of their operations. title: Competing in the Age of AI: Strategy and Leadership When Algorithms and Networks Run the W
description: "a provocative new book" — The New York Times AI-centric organizations exhibit a new operating architecture, redefining how they create, capture, share, and deliver value. When traditional operating constraints are removed, strategy becomes a whole new game, one whose rules and likely outcomes this book will make clear. title: Manufacturing AI: Building the Data Foundation for the Next Industrial Revolution
description: Turn Manufacturing Data into a Scalable Competitive Advantage Factories create massive amounts of data from IoT sensors, MES, SCADA, quality systems, supply chain, maintenance, and others. Yet most organizations can’t turn it into decisions fast enough. The result is reactive firefighting and AI pilots that stall. The Unified Manufacturing Data Architecture (UMDA) is a practical framework built for industry, not adapted from IT. It shows you how to handle real-time streams, integrate legacy systems, enforce security, and scale AI across sites. Stop drowning in data.
